environment_setting: Country B, City X, where political ambitions are common, and some citizens are willing to take unethical shortcuts to achieve power.
norm_base: Citizens 2-3 payments under 5000 dollars total might face Imprisonment 6 months; fine 5000 dollars

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: secure an appointive office in the local government

legitimate.legitimate_action: Applying for the appointive office through the official process
legitimate.benefits: Gains the position through ethical means, builds a positive reputation

character_profile.name: Jane Smith

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring unethical practices in the appointment process
illegal.costs: If discovered, risks job loss and legal consequences

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising clients on legal ways to enhance their political careers
legitimate.benefits: Earns income ethically, avoids legal risks
